scope: Read-only inspection of installed connector source; no connector execution, OAuth configuration or real mailbox access
notes: No structuredContent, recipients, subject or body are returned on native send success; they must remain bound to the action arguments.
The connector builds the MIME message and then calls gmail.users.messages.send. It does not prove delivery or read status.
The synthetic service saves all received arguments and every dispatch, including extra addresses and duplicates; it does not enforce product scope.
Known business failures use the existing error-message classification. Unrecognized write errors and malformed success receipts remain unknown.
Normal user body text containing Error is separate from the entire connector envelope.
